colorPrimary.$description: Brand color is one of the most direct visual elements to reflect the characteristics and communication of the product.

colorPrimaryBg.$description: Light background color of primary color, usually used for weak visual level selection state.

colorBgBase.$description: Used to derive the base variable of the text color gradient. In v5, we added a layer of text color derivation algorithm to produce gradient variables of text color gradient. But please do not use this Seed Token directly in the code!

colorWhite.$description: Pure white color don't changed by theme

colorTextBase.$description: Used to derive the base variable of the text color gradient. In v5, we added a layer of text color derivation algorithm to produce gradient variables of text color gradient. But please do not use this Seed Token directly in the code!

colorBorder.$description: Default border color, used to separate different elements, such as: form separator, card separator, etc.

colorBorderSecondary.$description: Slightly lighter than the default border color, this color is the same as `colorSplit`. Solid color is used.

colorBgMask.$description: The background color of the mask, used to cover the content below the mask, Modal, Drawer and other components use this token

colorSuccess.$description: Used to represent the token sequence of operation success, such as Result, Progress and other components will use these map tokens.

colorSuccessBg.$description: Light background color of success color, used for Tag and Alert success state background color

colorSuccessBgHover.$description: Light background color of success color, but antd does not use this token currently

colorWarning.$description: Used to represent the warning map token, such as Notification, Alert, etc. Alert or Control component(like Input) will use these map tokens.

colorError.$description: Used to represent the visual elements of the operation failure, such as the error Button, error Result component, etc.

colorInfo.$description: Used to represent the operation information of the Token sequence, such as Alert, Tag, Progress, and other components use these map tokens.

controlHeight.$description: The height of the basic controls such as buttons and input boxes in Ant Design

fontFamily.$value: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Noto Color Emoji'

lineWidthBold.$description: The default line width of the outline class components, such as Button, Input, Select, etc.

borderRadiusLG.$description: LG size border radius, used in some large border radius components, such as Card, Modal and other components.

borderRadiusSM.$description: SM size border radius, used in small size components, such as Button, Input, Select and other input components in small size

borderRadiusXS.$description: XS size border radius, used in some small border radius components, such as Segmented, Arrow and other components.

sizeStep.$description: The base step of size change, the size step combined with the size change unit, can derive various size steps. By adjusting the step, you can get different layout modes, such as the size step of the compact mode of V5 is 2

sizeUnit.$description: The unit of size change, in Ant Design, our base unit is 4, which is more fine-grained control of the size step
